philippians.4.p1.b1.text: Therefore, my brothers, whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, that is how you must stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.

philippians.4.p1.b2.text: I urge Euodia and Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord.

philippians.4.p1.b3.text: Yes, and I ask you, my true yokefellow, to help these women who have labored with me for the gospel, …

philippians.4.p1.b4.text: … along with Clement and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the Book of Life.

philippians.4.p2.b1.text: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!

philippians.4.p2.b2.text: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

philippians.4.p2.b3.text: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

philippians.4.p3.b1.text: Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable—if anything is excellent or praiseworthy—think on these things.

philippians.4.p3.b2.text: Whatever you have learned or received or heard from me, or seen in me, put it into practice. And the God of peace will be with you.

philippians.4.p4.b1.text: Now I rejoice greatly in the Lord that at last you have revived your concern for me. You were indeed concerned, but you had no opportunity to show it.

philippians.4.p4.b2.text: … I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances. … I am accustomed to any and every situation—to being filled and being hungry, to having plenty and having need.

philippians.4.p4.b3.text: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.

philippians.4.p5.b1.text: Nevertheless, you have done well to share in my affliction.

philippians.4.p5.b2.text: And as you Philippians know, in the early days of the gospel, when I left Macedonia, no church but you partnered with me in the matter of giving and receiving.

philippians.4.p5.b3.text: For even while I was in Thessalonica, you provided for my needs again and again.

philippians.4.p5.b4.text: Not that I am seeking a gift, but I am looking for the fruit that may be credited to your account.

philippians.4.p6.b1.text: I have all I need and more, now that I have received your gifts from Epaphroditus. …

philippians.4.p6.b2.text: … They are a fragrant offering, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.

philippians.4.p6.b3.text: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.

philippians.4.p6.b4.text: To our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen.

philippians.4.p7.b1.text: Greet all the saints in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me send you greetings.

philippians.4.p7.b2.text: All the saints send you greetings, especially those from the household of Caesar.

philippians.4.p7.b3.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
